name: 黃儀婷
objective: This course explores the theories, practices, and evolving forms of interactive advertising in digital and social media environments. The course examines how interactivity, user participation, and social media dynamics reshape contemporary advertising communication.Key topics include the development of interactive advertising, social media interactivity, online advertising evolution, online community user behavior, and meme marketing. Through lectures, case studies, discussions, and presentations, students will develop analytical and research-oriented perspectives on interactive advertising phenomena.
